Church & Dwight is seeking an AI Engineer to join our R&D Agentic Pod team, which is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-powered products that transform how R&D teams make decisions and operate. **About The Role**
The AI Engineer, R&D will translate R&D business requirements into secure, scalable AI products that combine enterprise knowledge, approved data, machine learning models, tools, and human oversight. The AI Engineer builds the technical foundations that enable agents and generative AI applications to operate reliably in the enterprise.
  
  
Working closely with R&D, Quality, & Regulatory stakeholders, AI Champions, Data Scientists, GTA partners, enterprise architecture, security, data engineering, and platform teams, this role contributes from prototype through deployment, monitoring, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by solution quality, accuracy, reliability, security, maintainability, user adoption, business impact, cost and latency performance, and delivery of reusable generative AI capabilities.
  
  
The role sits within the Global Technology and Analytics (GTA) R&D Innovation & AI organization, reporting to the Lead, R&D Agentic Pod.

**Role Accountabilities And Responsibilities**

* Translate R&D business needs into secure, scalable AI products combining approved enterprise knowledge, structured and unstructured data, models, tools, permissions, and human oversight.
* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain LLM and generative AI applications, agentic workflows, and orchestration patterns covering planning, routing, tool use, memory, handoffs, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build and optimize RAG systems using vector databases, embeddings, chunking, indexing, metadata, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and source attribution; create traceable ingestion and refresh processes.
* Engineer reusable production prompts and integrations for generative AI APIs, enterprise services, applications, analytical models, workflow tools, and knowledge repositories.
* Develop automated and human evaluations for accuracy, groundedness, safety, relevance, task completion, latency, cost, and usability; monitor quality, adoption, incidents, and business outcomes.
* Identify hallucination, prompt injection, tool, retrieval, and operational risks; implement guardrails, fallbacks, authentication, authorization, logging, secrets management, and data controls.
* Apply strong software engineering practices, including modular design, source control, code review, automated testing, documentation, release management, observability, and production support.
* Partner with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Data Science, GTA, architecture, data engineering, platform, security, privacy, and governance teams from discovery and prototyping through deployment, training, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, privacy, security, legal, compliance, data governance, and responsible AI standards; document architecture, controls, dependencies, procedures, limitations, and intended use.

* Action-oriented, data-driven problem solver focused on measurable outcomes.
* Strategic systems thinker with strong technical, business, and product acumen.
* Collaborative, curious, and accountable; effective in ambiguity and influencing without authority.

* Generative AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, model optimization.
* RAG & Agents: Embeddings, vector databases, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, orchestration, memory, human oversight.
* Engineering: Python, APIs, SDKs, cloud AI, authentication, source control, automated testing.
* AI Operations: Evaluation, observability, safety, failure analysis, monitoring, latency and cost optimization.
* Governance: Responsible AI, privacy, security, data governance, access controls, documentation, auditability.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required.

* Hands-on experience building LLM and generative AI applications, including production prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, model selection, APIs, evaluation, testing, monitoring, and optimization.
* Experience building enterprise RAG solutions with vector databases, embeddings, retrieval pipelines, knowledge sources, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and source attribution.
* Experience with agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, routing, handoffs, memory patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Proficiency in Python, REST APIs and SDKs, cloud AI services, source control, automated testing, authentication, and authorization.
